title: Arena Game Terms & Rules
subtitle: Guidelines and fair play policies governing the live multiplayer game at the Incubation Lab Inauguration Event.

sections.title: 1. Event Participation & Eligibility
content: Participation is exclusively open to registered attendees and students connected to the local Incubation Lab Wi-Fi network.
Each attendee is assigned a unique Guest ID and matching Orb Number upon entrance.

sections.title: 2. Fair Play & One-Device Rule
content: Each player must participate using only one mobile device. Multiple device registration or botting is strictly prohibited.
Scores and round answers are atomically verified by the local server. Any attempt to tamper with client storage or bypass timers results in disqualification.

sections.title: 3. Scoring & Leaderboard Rules
content: Points are awarded based on answer correctness and response speed.
The live scoreboard is continuously synchronized via local WebSockets. All leaderboard standings decided by the game engine at round close are final.

sections.title: 4. Local Network & Offline Environment
content: The game operates in an air-gapped local venue network with zero external internet connectivity.
Players must remain connected to the official Incubation Lab Wi-Fi throughout the live challenge to ensure real-time score updates.

sections.title: 5. Code of Conduct & Prizes
content: All attendees agree to maintain sportsmanlike conduct throughout the inauguration tournament.
Inauguration event winners will be announced immediately following the conclusion of the final round.
